questions.question: Explain Association Rule Mining with support and confidence.
questions.solution_html:
•  (2 marks) – Introduction/Definition
  • → Association rule mining finds relationships/patterns among items in large datasets
  •  (3 marks) – Basic Concepts
  • → Itemset (set of items)
  • → Frequent itemset
  • → Rule form: X→Y
  •  (4 marks) – Measures (with explanation & formula)
  • → Support: frequency of occurrence of itemset
  • → Confidence: likelihood that Y occurs given X
  • → (1–(2 marks) for formula + explanation)
  •  (4 marks) – Algorithm (brief)
  • → Apriori Algoithm
  •  (2 marks) – Example
  • → Market basket analysis (e.g., bread → butter) with support/confidence
questions.final_answer: → Market basket analysis (e.g., bread → butter) with support/confidence

questions.question: Describe the Naïve Bayes Classification algorithm with suitable example.
questions.solution_html:
•  (2 marks) – Introduction/Definition
  • → Probabilistic classifier based on Bayes’ theorem
  •  (3 marks) – Bayes Theorem Explanation
  • → P(H∣X) = P(X∣H)P(H)/P(X)
  • → Meaning of prior, likelihood, posterior
  •  (3 marks) – Naïve Assumption
  • → Features are conditionally independent
  •  (5 marks) – Algorithm Steps
  • → Calculate prior probabilities
  • → Compute likelihood
  • → Apply formula
  • → Choose class with highest probability
  •  (2 marks) – Example
  • → Spam detection simple dataset classification
